verdict.rationale: Radar's rules engine lets users define conditions (new customer, country, dispute rate, value lists) that trigger automatic actions like blocking, requesting 3DS, reviewing, or pausing payouts, and rules can reference custom attributes/value lists — a solid automation-on-events model. However, community evidence indicates real limits on programmatic control (comm-2 notes 'lack of easy programmatic control') and that Allow Rules aren't even enabled by default and require a manual support request to activate (comm-7), undercutting full AI-native/automated self-service rule deployment. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating/updating rules programmatically (only review-approval API is shown), and evidence that rule changes can be deployed without dashboard/manual steps.
